caption: A fingertip holds down the doorbell button beside a front door, and a small light in the button glows while it is pressed and goes out when it is released.

sa.check: A doorbell button beside a front door.
A fingertip holds the button down.
A small light in the button glows while it is pressed.
The light goes out when the button is released.
The button is dark before the press.
The order is dark, press and glow, release and dark.

pc.expect: The light comes on when the fingertip presses the button and goes out when the finger lifts; it glows only while pressed.
pc.fail: The button is pressed and stays dark; or glows before the finger reaches it; or stays lit after the finger has lifted; or goes out while the finger still holds it down.

pc.expect: While the button is held the glow is steady; after release the button stays dark for the rest of the clip.
pc.fail: The glow flickers while the button is held steady; or comes back on after release with nothing touching it; or the button lights and goes out repeatedly during one press.

pc.expect: The door, the frame and the button plate stay still; only the finger and the button's small travel move.
pc.fail: The door opens at the press with no one behind it; or the plate slides on the wall; or the button sinks deep into the wall and stays sunk.

pc.expect: The glow is small: it lights the button and its rim and no more.
pc.fail: The whole doorway lights up when the button glows; or the glow appears on the wall away from the button; or the porch light comes on at the press.

pc.expect: One button on one plate; the finger touches the button and passes through nothing; the door keeps its shape.
pc.fail: A second button appears; or the finger passes into the wall; or the plate vanishes; or the door changes shape.

pc.expect: The door's colour, the plate's finish and the wall stay the same apart from the glow.
pc.fail: The door changes colour; or the plate changes shape or finish; or the glow changes colour.

note: The hand is kept because the caption's event is the press; the person is otherwise not judged. The chime is sound and is not judged.
